name: Tokyo Mirage Sessions #FE Encore
storyline: A crossover role-playing game blending the styles of the Shin Megami Tensei and Fire Emblem series, Tokyo Mirage Sessions takes place in a vibrant, modern-day Tokyo built around real districts such as Shibuya and Harajuku. Beneath the city's glamorous entertainment scene lurks a hidden threat: hostile otherworldly beings known as Mirages, who invade the human world to harvest a life energy called Performa and leave a trail of mysterious disappearances in their wake. The story follows a group of teenagers with dreams of stardom who find themselves caught up in this secret war. Allying with benevolent Mirages modeled on heroes from the Fire Emblem games, they merge with these spirits to become Mirage Masters, warriors capable of battling their malevolent counterparts. Operating under the cover of the Fortuna Entertainment talent agency, the young heroes juggle their budding show-business careers with a dangerous mission to protect the innocent and uncover the sinister force orchestrating the attacks.
summary: You and the rising stars you call friends will need to call on your own creative power - manifested as iconic Fire Emblem characters - to wage a secret war on rogue spirits that feed on creativity. Each encounter will immerse you in deep, turn-based battles that blend the combat of the Fire Emblem and Shin Megami Tensei series into one brutal harmony. Fuse items to craft weaponry; then play to your strengths and crush your foes. Around every corner you'll find fun nods to multiple fandoms, including Fire Emblem references, dungeons themed to the entertainment industry, and stunning musical performances.
